description: Use this when the user wants to modify details of the currently running timer task, such as description, location, billability, or mood rating.

billable.description: Whether this time should be billed to the client

description.description: Task description or notes about what work is being done

distance.description: Distance travelled, for a trip entry

feeling.description: Mood or satisfaction rating from 1 (poor) to 5 (excellent)

location.description: Physical location where work started (e.g., "Office", "Home", "Client site")

phoneNumber.description: Phone number, for a call entry

startDateTime.description: New start time of the running task in ISO 8601 with offset (e.g., "2026-09-24T09:15:00+02:00")

typeId.description: Entry type: 0 for work time, 1 for a trip (mileage), 2 for a call

name: timer_update

duration.description: Duration of the running task in seconds

pause.description: The current break, while the timer is paused

task.description: The running task, with its project. Absent when no timer runs.

title: Update Timer Task
